head: codex/515-v0-92-1-prov-b-local-model-shadow-execution
title: [v0.92.1][PROV-B] Add local-model shadow execution
body:
Closes #515

## Summary

- Adds an opt-in, local-only provider shadow execution path via `providers.<id>.config.local_shadow_model`.
- Wires the shadow wrapper through `build_provider_for_id`, which is the provider factory used by local `execute_sequential` and remote-exec provider paths.
- Preserves authoritative provider output as the only accepted result; local/shadow output is recorded only as redacted observation metadata.
- Handles returned shadow errors and shadow panics as redacted failed observations while keeping unrelated panic-hook observability intact.
- Requires relative shadow-evidence paths and rejects host-local/absolute evidence markers in the PROV-B validators.

## Local open-PR shadow smoke

- Used local Ollama `phi4-mini:latest` as a non-authoritative shadow reviewer over current open PR prompts for #618 and #614.
- The accepted result stayed fixture-controlled authoritative review output; local model output was not authority.
- Durable evidence records only redacted shadow digest/class metadata, not raw prompts, PR titles, private payload markers, `/private/tmp`, `/Volumes/...`, or absolute `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/...` paths.

## Validation

- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml -p adl provider_mod_build_provider_wires_configured_local_shadow_without_authority -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture` — passed.
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml -p adl provider_mod_shadow -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture` — passed.
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml -p adl runner_local_provider_invokes_configured_shadow_without_authority -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture` — passed.
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml -p adl --test provider_shadow_isolation --test provider_shadow_comparison --test provider_shadow_fallback -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture` — passed, 6 tests.
- `ADL_PROVIDER_SHADOW_OPEN_PR_MODEL=phi4-mini:latest CARGO_TARGET_DIR=.adl/target/515-provider-shadow-smoke cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml -p adl --test provider_shadow_open_pr_review -- --ignored --nocapture` — passed; exercised PR #618 and #614 prompts through local Ollama shadow.
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/515/validate-provider-shadow-readiness.sh` — passed.
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/515/validate-provider-shadow-redaction.sh` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --check` — passed.
- `csdlc-doctor --issue 515` and `csdlc-validate issue --issue 515` — passed at reviewed generation 27.

## Review

- Fresh bounded exact-head review recorded PASS by `fresh-session:4af50d8b-e397-4cab-a8fa-3aae6c92c822` with no P0-P3 findings.
- Reviewed revision: `git-blake3:b41443094d38109cd9d87c4462ad95b0bd992c79:df29f83e8b6abe1e57136c16872e28348f7370d81288e7c107d7d88f497d9442`.
- Review limitation retained: the local Ollama smoke uses hard-coded real PR prompt material for #618/#614 rather than fetching live PR body/diff material at test runtime.

No AWS, cloud spend, or paid runner use was performed.
